outcome: adverse perinatal outcomes (including NICU admission >48h and neonatal sepsis)
cohort: The study included 202 singleton women fulfilling the criteria of severe features of pre-eclampsia.
finding: In women with severe pre-eclampsia, severe and massive proteinuria were related to composite adverse perinatal outcomes but not composite adverse maternal outcomes, and antenatal 24-h proteinuria was associated with persistent proteinuria.
